provenance: AI-generated original first-person harlequin mallet sheet, requested for Toronto Realms. Not extracted from Doom or another game's weapon artwork.
conversion: scripts/build_toronto_wad.py::_mallet_weapon_lumps crops poses, uses one scale with Doom pixel-aspect compensation, thresholds alpha and quantizes without dithering to the installed Doom palette.
